en: Sura 85: Al-Buruj

p.src: 85:1  By the sky full of constellations,

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
en: By the sky full of constellations,
u.src: 85:1  By the sky full of constellations,

p.src: 85:2  and by the promised Day,

en: and by the promised Day,
u.src: 85:2  and by the promised Day,

p.src: 85:3  and by the witness and the witnessed,

en: and by the witness and the witnessed,
u.src: 85:3  and by the witness and the witnessed,

p.src: 85:4  cursed be the makers of the trench[1],

en: cursed be the makers of the trench[1],
u.src: 85:4  cursed be the makers of the trench[1],

en: [1] Those who worked for a tyrannical king and did not allow the people to believe in Allah. Their blind obedience to their ruler incurred upon them the curse of Allah.

p.src: 85:5  the fire full of fuel,

en: the fire full of fuel,
u.src: 85:5  the fire full of fuel,

p.src: 85:6  when they sat around it,

en: when they sat around it,
u.src: 85:6  when they sat around it,

p.src: 85:7  and were witnessing what they did to the believers[2].

ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
en: and were witnessing what they did to the believers[2].
u.src: 85:7  and were witnessing what they did to the believers[2].

en: [2] After the believers were casted into a trench of fire, they sat around it watching them burn to death. It occurred long before Prophet Muhammad's (ﷺ) time.

p.src: 85:8  Their only grievance against them was that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Praiseworthy,

ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
en: Their only grievance against them was that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Praiseworthy,
u.src: 85:8  Their only grievance against them was that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Praiseworthy,

p.src: 85:9  to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, and Allah is Witness over all things.

ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
en: to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, and Allah is Witness over all things.
u.src: 85:9  to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, and Allah is Witness over all things.

p.src: 85:10  Indeed, for those who tortured the believing men and women, and then did not repent, there will be the punishment of Hell and the punishment of the burning fire[3].

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
en: Indeed, for those who tortured the believing men and women, and then did not repent, there will be the punishment of Hell and the punishment of the burning fire[3].
u.src: 85:10  Indeed, for those who tortured the believing men and women, and then did not repent, there will be the punishment of Hell and the punishment of the burning fire[3].

en: [3] Those who burned the believers will be punished with the burning fire in the Hereafter.

p.src: 85:11  But those who believed and did righteous deeds will certainly have gardens under which rivers flow; that is the supreme triumph.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
en: But those who believed and did righteous deeds will certainly have gardens under which rivers flow; that is the supreme triumph.
u.src: 85:11  But those who believed and did righteous deeds will certainly have gardens under which rivers flow; that is the supreme triumph.

p.src: 85:12  Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is severe.

en: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is severe.
u.src: 85:12  Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is severe.

p.src: 85:13  Indeed, it is He Who originates [the creation] and then resurrects all,

en: Indeed, it is He Who originates [the creation] and then resurrects all,
u.src: 85:13  Indeed, it is He Who originates [the creation] and then resurrects all,

p.src: 85:14  and He is the All-Forgiving, the Most Affectionate,

en: and He is the All-Forgiving, the Most Affectionate,
u.src: 85:14  and He is the All-Forgiving, the Most Affectionate,

p.src: 85:15  the Lord of the Glorious Throne;

en: the Lord of the Glorious Throne;
u.src: 85:15  the Lord of the Glorious Throne;

p.src: 85:16  He does whatever He wills.

en: He does whatever He wills.
u.src: 85:16  He does whatever He wills.

p.src: 85:17  Has there not come to you the story of the forces

en: Has there not come to you the story of the forces
u.src: 85:17  Has there not come to you the story of the forces

p.src: 85:18  of Pharaoh and Thamūd?

en: of Pharaoh and Thamūd?
u.src: 85:18  of Pharaoh and Thamūd?

p.src: 85:19  But the disbelievers are in persistent denial,

en: But the disbelievers are in persistent denial,
u.src: 85:19  But the disbelievers are in persistent denial,

p.src: 85:20  although Allah encompasses them from all sides.

en: although Allah encompasses them from all sides.
u.src: 85:20  although Allah encompasses them from all sides.

p.src: 85:21  But this is a glorious Qur’an,

en: But this is a glorious Qur’an,
u.src: 85:21  But this is a glorious Qur’an,

p.src: 85:22  [inscribed] in a Preserved Tablet.

en: [inscribed] in a Preserved Tablet.
u.src: 85:22  [inscribed] in a Preserved Tablet.
